title: Misc Spelunkery Compat
description: Datapack which patches some some loot tables of some mods to fit better with Spelunkery.
body:
This is a datapack that modifies some loot tables of a few mods to account for [Spelunkery](https://modrinth.com/mod/spelunkery)'s new rough gems, raw ore nuggets, etc.

- [Majrusz's Accessories](https://modrinth.com/mod/majruszs-accessories)
  - Lucky Rock: Replaced Lapis Lazuli, Emerald, Diamond, and Redstone drops with Lazurite, Rough Emerald, Rough Diamond, and Rough Cinnabar.
  - Lucky Rock: Added rough gem shards and raw ore nuggets as new uncommon drops, will drop multiple if picked. Made uncommon because this is effectively a nerf.
  - Lucky Rock: Added Dust Bun and Nephrite Chunk as new rare drops.
  - Lucky Rock: Replaced Gold Nugget drops with Raw Gold Nuggets in the Nether.
  - Lucky Rock: Added Rough Quartz Shards as a new uncommon drop in the Nether, will drop multiple if picked. Made uncommon because this is effectively a nerf.
  - Lucky Rock: Added Raw Gold as a new rare drop in the Nether.
- [Piglet Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/piglet-structures)
  - Nether Rich Gold Ore: Replaced Gold Nugget drops with Raw Gold Nuggets.
- [The Gold Rush](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-gold-rush)
  - Sand Gold Ore: Removed Gold Sheet, Raw Gold Ore, and Gold Ingot drops.
  - Sand Gold Ore: Replaced Gold Nugget drops with Raw Gold Nuggets.
  - Sand Gold Ore: Reworked loot table to work similarly to Nether Gold Ore.
